purpose: Preserve fail-closed intake events separately from canonical success evidence.

events.error: official README missing required source statements: ['privacy_blur']
events.cause: The pinned README wrapped the phrase across a newline; matching was not whitespace-normalized.
events.resolution: Normalize official README whitespace before checking the pinned privacy statement.

events.cause: The dry-run disk probe targeted a not-yet-created destination parent.
events.resolution: Probe the nearest existing ancestor without creating the raw destination during dry-run.

events.error: Operator KeyboardInterrupt after official endpoint measured about 24 KB/s per connection.
events.cause: Single-connection public GCS throughput would have unnecessarily serialized the intake.
events.resolution: Preserve the 2 MiB .part, add an aggregate disk reservation and at most eight per-object guarded network workers, then resume the same generation-pinned object with HTTP Range.

events.error: destination contains a different SANPO intake plan
events.cause: The first plan identity included a live free-disk observation, so concurrent CM7 disk changes altered the hash.
events.resolution: Restrict plan identity to immutable authority, cohort, split and safety-policy fields; retain the legacy dynamic hash in intake_plan.json.

events.error: Transient SSL EOF while re-fetching one generation-pinned description during an optional authority refresh.
events.cause: Public endpoint transport interruption; previously acquired bytes and independent local verification remained intact.
events.resolution: Apply the claim-language migration from the already verified immutable plan, re-hash all 94 local official files, and regenerate canonical success receipts without weakening any authority check.

claim_boundary: Engineering failures are evidence about intake hardening only. They are not scientific nulls or promotions.
